implementation_constraints: Preserve the independent animated den actor when an enemy record activates.
Support overlap between the den actor and a released enemy immediately after release.
Use restore-all, update-all, save-all, draw-all compositing; never let one actor's save buffer capture another actor.
Framebuffer changes outside the union of old and new actor rectangles are a test failure.
